raw_response:
I am old now, sixty years, and this small maize plot is just for our family to eat. The land is ours, thanks be to God, but money is scarce and the cooperative fertilizer comes late or not at all here in Benshangul. I will put some manure from our animals because that costs nothing, and I will plant the seed I saved from last harvest like my mother taught me. My sons help me weed when the rains come, but I cannot pay anyone.
